findings.problem: ADR-FIN-039 and the SRS field note on ENT-FIN-015.businessValue require trimming on save and on event read. No plan block says so: API-FIN-039/040 and QR-FIN-052/055 say only 'EXACT'. The same fields{} map feeds dimension resolution (API-FIN-020 step 7, QR-FIN-058), where no trim applies. As a result 'CHEQUE ' resolves a mapping but 'BR-07 ' fails RULE-FIN-027. A businessValue that is blank after trimming is still accepted on save for host-coded fields such as EXPENSE_TYPE_CODE (ADR-FIN-050, carried from the previous gate as MINOR). The operator's escalation fix did not take it up; it is carried here, not re-escalated.
findings.fix: State one normalisation rule once, in CORE 'Event business fields': every fields[<code>] value and every submitted businessValue is trimmed before use. Blank after trimming counts as absent: on the event path it is FIN-422-MISSING-BUSINESS-FIELD (RULE-FIN-021 already says 'absent or blank'), and on save it is FIN-400 validation. Cite that sentence from API-FIN-020 steps 5 and 7, API-FIN-039, API-FIN-040, QR-FIN-052, QR-FIN-055 and QR-FIN-058. Applying the trim to dimension-tag reads extends ADR-FIN-039 and needs the adr flag.
